findings.summary: Request ids of archived tasks become reusable after bank entries are dropped
findings.evidence: ask rejects an id only if present in pending/bank (session.ail:219). Same behaviour already exists via compacted(); the bank comment says it is for 'id uniqueness' too, but expiry already makes retries inert. Host id generation should stay unique; not tested.

complete() bank hit returns Ok only for an identical retry; fresh answers require tick < r.expires (stale check, line 256), and an entry was created only when tick < expires, so after expiry no apply path remains. expires = min(due, tick+1) is the right field. cancel/compacted only read bank by expiry. Non-expired requests keep held() true, so their tasks cannot archive. Edge: retry after expiry of an archived answer now says 'unknown request' instead of no-op Ok (documented).
